history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends the Administration set, for each strategy, appropriate implementation milestones and performance indicators in order to monitor results and take the actions necessary at the level of the Department of Operational Support and after close consultations with the peacekeeping missions.
history.administration_response: The Administration has regrouped 40 category strategies into core and bespoke categories under which the Office of Supply Chain Management will provide end-to-end support for core categories, while the bespoke categories will be delegated to another business lead, with needs-based support provided by the Office. In the meantime, the Office has begun to prioritize the implementation of core category strategies by developing implementation milestones in which the performance of each category strategies will be built by the specific category team. Taking into account the progress made in improving overall category management approach as recommended by the Board, the Administration requests the closure of the recommendation.
history.board_assessment: As for the previous recommendation, the adoption of strategies for all core strategies responds to the Board’s recommendation, which can be considered implemented.
